visual_identity.core_identity: A squat winged stone predator disguised as architectural sculpture until it begins to move.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad crouched humanoid body, folded batlike wings, horned head, clawed hands and feet, heavy stone posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Grotesque stone face with short horns, heavy brow, broad nose, and fanged mouth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact muscular humanoid carved from stone, thick forearms, bent legs, folded wings.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two stone arms, two clawed stone legs, and one pair of batlike wings attached to the back.
visual_identity.surface: Stone planes with a few cracks and chipped edges, not dense masonry texture.

accuracy_checks: reads as stone sculpture becoming alive

known_failure_modes.correction: restore crouched humanoid torso, two arms, two legs, and back wings
restore grotesque horned stone features and heavy crouch
use broad stone planes with only a few cracks and chips

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium dense stone humanoid whose weight is reinforced by architecture and a substantial perch.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Crouched on a stone support, gripping architecture, or launching with at least one clear contact point.
behavior_style: peeling from a gate or arch
environment_fit: ruined masonry and underground architectural thresholds
